references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.70 para 2: where the employer terminates the employment, "wage, overtime pay, holiday pay and holiday overtime pay" are paid "within three days as from the employment termination date" (text as in the Council of State translation; s.70 as amended by LPA (No. 7) B.E. 2562 keeps the three-day rule; https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf). Severance (s.118) and the annual-leave pay of s.67 are owed on termination without this deadline.

FINAL_PAY.description: Raises final wages and termination pay within three days of a dismissal, redundancy, retirement or contract end (LPA s.70).

WITHHOLDING_CERTIFICATE_ON_EXIT.name: Withholding certificate to a leaving employee (50 Tawi)

references.title: Revenue Code s.50 bis; Revenue Department guidance on withholding certificates: within one month of the day the employee leaves during the tax year.

WITHHOLDING_CERTIFICATE_ON_EXIT.description: Raises the leaving employee's withholding certificate within one month of exit (Revenue Code s.50 bis).

FOREIGN_WORKER_HIRE_NOTIFICATION.name: Notify the registrar of a foreign employee taken on

references.title: Royal Ordinance on the Management of the Employment of Foreign Workers B.E. 2560 s.13 (as amended by the Royal Ordinance (No. 2) B.E. 2561): the employer notifies the registrar of the name, nationality and work of a foreign worker within 15 days of employing them, and within 15 days of the day the worker leaves, with the reason; an employer whose foreign staff are permitted under the investment-promotion or petroleum law (s.62) is exempt (employee fact work_permit_basis SECTION_62). Department of Employment, Chiang Mai Provincial Employment Office briefing:

FOREIGN_WORKER_HIRE_NOTIFICATION.description: Raises the registrar notification for a newly employed foreign worker within 15 days (Foreign Workers Royal Ordinance s.13).

FOREIGN_WORKER_EXIT_NOTIFICATION.name: Notify the registrar of a foreign employee leaving

references.title: Royal Ordinance on the Management of the Employment of Foreign Workers B.E. 2560 s.13 (as amended by the Royal Ordinance (No. 2) B.E. 2561): the employer notifies the registrar of the name, nationality and work of a foreign worker within 15 days of employing them, and within 15 days of the day the worker leaves, with the reason; an employer whose foreign staff are permitted under the investment-promotion or petroleum law (s.62) is exempt (employee fact work_permit_basis SECTION_62). Department of Employment, Chiang Mai Provincial Employment Office briefing:

FOREIGN_WORKER_EXIT_NOTIFICATION.description: Raises the registrar notification when a foreign worker leaves within 15 days (Foreign Workers Royal Ordinance s.13).

WCF_ADDITIONAL_CONTRIBUTION.name: Workmen's Compensation Fund additional contribution (Kor Tor 25 Kor)

references.title: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.15 para 2: an additional contribution from the cl.14 statement is paid within March; WCA s.46: 2% a month on late payment.
references.url: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf

WCF_ADDITIONAL_CONTRIBUTION.description: Raises the additional WCF contribution from the annual wage statement, due in March (2019 MOL notification cl.15).

EMPLOYER_REGISTRATION.name: Register as an employer with the Social Security Office (Sor Por Sor 1-01) and the WCF

references.title: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.34 and Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 as amended by the Workmen's Compensation Act (No. 2) B.E. 2561 s.44: the employer files the registration within 30 days of the day it first has an employee (SSO WCF employer guide: "ขึ้นทะเบียนนายจ้าง พร้อมกับขึ้นทะเบียนลูกจ้าง ภายใน 30 วัน").

EMPLOYER_REGISTRATION.description: Raises the employer's SSO and WCF registration within 30 days of the first employee (SSA s.34; WCA s.44).

WORK_RULES.name: Announce work rules in Thai (10 employees)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.108: an employer of ten or more has work rules in Thai, announced within 15 days of the day the employees reach ten, posted and kept at the workplace (Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)). The former duty to send a copy to the Director-General was repealed by Order of the Head of the NCPO No. 21/2560 (4 April 2017; summarised by Tilleke & Gibbins, https://www.tilleke.com/ja/insights/thailand-amendments-labor-protection-act). Raised on the hire that brings the contracts in force to ten.

WORK_RULES.description: Raises work rules in Thai for an employer reaching ten employees, due within 15 days (LPA s.108).

WORK_INJURY_NOTIFICATION.name: Notify the SSO of a work injury (Kor Tor 16)

references.title: Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 as amended by the Workmen's Compensation Act (No. 2) B.E. 2561 s.48: "ให้นายจ้างแจ้งเหตุดังกล่าวต่อสำนักงาน … ภายในสิบห้าวันนับแต่วันที่นายจ้างทราบ" — within 15 days of the day the employer knows. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/assets/upload/files_storage/sso_th/84244ea51a2464c0713a98ddd8cc0955.pdf Raised by a WORK_INJURY_LEAVE entry; its first day stands for the day the employer knew.

WORK_INJURY_NOTIFICATION.description: Raises the SSO work-injury notification within 15 days of the injury date (WCA s.48).

WCF_CLOSING_WAGE_STATEMENT.name: WCF wage statement on closing the business

references.title: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.14 para 2: an employer that ceases business reports the wages "ภายในสามสิบวันนับแต่วันที่เลิกกิจการ". https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf Customer input: entity fact business_closed_on.
references.url: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf

WCF_CLOSING_WAGE_STATEMENT.description: Raises the WCF closing wage statement within 30 days of ceasing business (2019 MOL notification cl.14).

YOUNG_WORKER_HIRE_NOTICE.name: Notify the labour inspector of a child employee

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.45(1): employing a child under 18, the employer notifies the labour inspector within 15 days of the day the child starts work, and keeps a record of working conditions (s.45(2)). Office of the Council of State English translation.

YOUNG_WORKER_HIRE_NOTICE.description: Raises the labour-inspector notice for employing a child under 18 within 15 days (LPA s.45).

YOUNG_WORKER_EXIT_NOTICE.name: Notify the labour inspector that a child employee has left

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.45(3): notify the termination of a child's employment to the labour inspector within 7 days. Office of the Council of State English translation.

YOUNG_WORKER_EXIT_NOTICE.description: Raises the labour-inspector notice when a child employee leaves within seven days (LPA s.45).

TEMPORARY_SHUTDOWN_NOTICE.name: Notify a temporary cessation of business

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.75 para 2 (as replaced by Act No. 2 B.E. 2551): the employer informs the employees and the labour inspector in writing at least three working days before the cessation starts. Counted here in calendar days; move it earlier across a weekend or holiday.

TEMPORARY_SHUTDOWN_NOTICE.description: Raises written notice of a temporary cessation to employees and the labour inspector at least three days ahead (LPA s.75).

TECHNOLOGY_REDUNDANCY_NOTICE.name: Give 60 days' notice of a technology redundancy

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.121 para 1: the termination day, reason and list of employees go to the labour inspector and the employees at least 60 days before the termination; otherwise TECHNOLOGY_NOTICE_IN_LIEU is owed. Office of the Council of State English translation.

TECHNOLOGY_REDUNDANCY_NOTICE.description: Raises the 60-day technology-redundancy notice to employees and the labour inspector (LPA s.121).

RETIREMENT_SEVERANCE.name: Pay severance on retirement

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.118/1 (LPA (No. 6) B.E. 2560): retirement at the agreed age, or at 60 on 30 days' notice from the employee where no or a later age is agreed, is a termination owing s.118 severance (adhoc SEVERANCE_PAY). Secondary summary of the No. 6 text:

SECURITY_DEPOSIT_RETURN.name: Return the security deposit

references.title: Labour Protection Act s.10: return actual held security money and earned interest within seven days of termination; source deposit receipt cases record actual amounts and currency, not employee-standing booleans.

SECURITY_DEPOSIT_RETURN.description: Raises return of a held security deposit and its interest within seven days of exit (LPA s.10).

EMPLOYEE_REGISTER_UPDATE.name: Update the employee register

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.113: the register (name, sex, nationality, birth date, address, start, position, wage and benefits, end) is amended within 15 days of a change. Office of the Council of State English translation.

EMPLOYEE_REGISTER_UPDATE.description: Raises amendment of the employee register within 15 days of a register particular changing (LPA s.113).

RECORDS_RETENTION.name: Keep the employee register and wage records

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.114: an employer of ten or more keeps wage-payment documents signed by the employee or bank-transfer evidence; s.115: the register for at least two years after each exit and the wage documents two years after payment (longer while a complaint or labour case is open). Due is the earliest disposal day. Office of the Council of State English translation.

RECORDS_RETENTION.description: Raises the two-year retention point for the employee register and wage records after exit (LPA ss.114-115).

SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_REGISTRATION.name: Register with the Department of Skill Development (Sor Tor 1)

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 (as amended B.E. 2557): an employer of 100 or more registers (Sor Tor 1, Sor Tor 4) when it reaches 100 employees. Department of Skill Development guidance:; Act section 4 (state bodies excluded) and Ministry scope notice 9 April 2015 clause 4 (specified seasonal agriculture, private schools, private higher education and non-profit foundations/charities excluded); official DSD manual กสพ.-01-2568 appendix p.25.

SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_REGISTRATION.description: Raises Skill Development Fund registration for an employer reaching 100 employees (SDPA).

SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_COURSE_CERTIFICATION.name: Review outstanding annual training applications

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Committee notice dated 21 September 2016, clause 4; Royal Gazette vol.133 special part 262 Ngor, 16 November 2016, pp.1–2. Electronic applications for employee upskilling or retraining courses and costs: within 60 calendar days after completion, including public holidays, and no later than 15 January of the following year. Ministry of Labour official copy: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2020/10/109.e-Service-ฝึกยกระดับ-ฝึกเปลี่ยนสาขาอาชีพ.pdf. DSD operational guidance for FY2567 (November 2023), printed p.175, confirms the same deadline: https://eit2.dsd.go.th/~qrcode/qr1/PLAN/Plan_2566.pdf. Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 (as amended): training counted toward the 50% is certified within 60 days of the course ending and no later than 15 January of the following year. Department of Skill Development guidance: https://www.dsd.go.th/sdpaa/Region/Download_Doc/13824; Act section 4 (state bodies excluded) and Ministry scope notice 9 April 2015 clause 4 (specified seasonal agriculture, private schools, private higher education and non-profit foundations/charities excluded); official DSD manual กสพ.-01-2568 appendix p.25.

SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_COURSE_CERTIFICATION.description: Raises the January review of outstanding training-course certification for an employer of 100 or more (SDD notice 2016 cl.4).

SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_COURSE_APPLICATION.name: Apply for approval of the completed training course and costs

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Committee notice dated 21 September 2016, clause 4; Royal Gazette vol.133 special part 262 Ngor, 16 November 2016, pp.1–2. Electronic applications for employee upskilling or retraining courses and costs: within 60 calendar days after completion, including public holidays, and no later than 15 January of the following year. Ministry of Labour official copy: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2020/10/109.e-Service-ฝึกยกระดับ-ฝึกเปลี่ยนสาขาอาชีพ.pdf. DSD operational guidance for FY2567 (November 2023), printed p.175, confirms the same deadline: https://eit2.dsd.go.th/~qrcode/qr1/PLAN/Plan_2566.pdf.

SKILL_DEVELOPMENT_COURSE_APPLICATION.description: Raises the application to approve a completed training course and its costs within 60 days and by 15 January (SDD notice 2016 cl.4).

WCF_INSTALMENT_DEPOSIT.name: Deposit 25% of the year's WCF contribution (instalment payer)

references.title: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.16-17: an employer allowed to pay the WCF contribution by instalments (entity fact wcf_instalments, the SSO's approval) deposits 25% of the estimated year's contribution within January.
references.url: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf

WCF_INSTALMENT_DEPOSIT.description: Raises the 25 percent WCF deposit in January for an employer approved to pay by instalments (2019 MOL notification cl.16).

WCF_INSTALMENT.name: Pay the quarter's WCF instalment and report its wages

references.title: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.18: the instalment payer pays in four instalments a year, each within the month after its quarter ends, reporting the quarter's total wages.
references.url: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf

WCF_INSTALMENT.description: Raises each quarterly WCF instalment and its wage report (2019 MOL notification cl.18).

PDPA_PRIVACY_NOTICE.name: PDPA_PRIVACY_NOTICE

references.title: PDPA s.23 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

PDPA_PRIVACY_NOTICE.description: Raises the privacy notice at or before collecting an employee's personal data (PDPA s.23).

PDPA_SENSITIVE_DATA_CONSENT.name: PDPA_SENSITIVE_DATA_CONSENT

references.title: PDPA s.26 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

PDPA_SENSITIVE_DATA_CONSENT.description: Raises explicit consent before collecting sensitive personal data (PDPA s.26).

PDPA_BREACH_NOTICE.name: PDPA_BREACH_NOTICE

references.title: PDPA s.37(4) (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

PDPA_BREACH_NOTICE.description: Raises notification of a personal-data breach within 72 hours (PDPA s.37(4)).

PDPA_CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER.name: PDPA_CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER

references.title: PDPA ss.28–29 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

PDPA_CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER.description: Raises the record of a cross-border personal-data transfer (PDPA ss.28-29).

PDPA_PROCESSING_RECORDS.name: PDPA_PROCESSING_RECORDS

references.title: PDPA s.39 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation)

PDPA_PROCESSING_RECORDS.description: Raises the employer's record of personal-data processing activities (PDPA s.39).

PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL.name: PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL

references.title: PDPA s.37(3) (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation); Accounting Act B.E. 2543 s.14

PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL.description: Raises disposal of personal data after the retention period (PDPA s.37(3); Accounting Act s.14).

RELOCATION_POSTED_NOTICE.name: Post the workplace relocation notice

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120 paragraph 1; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

RELOCATION_POSTED_NOTICE.description: Raises the workplace-relocation notice 30 days before the move (LPA s.120).

RELOCATION_SPECIAL_PAYMENT.name: Assess and pay relocation special compensation

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120 paragraphs 2-4; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

RELOCATION_SPECIAL_PAYMENT.description: Raises assessment of special compensation for an employee who refuses relocation (LPA s.120).

RELOCATION_BOARD_PETITION.name: Petition the Labour Welfare Committee on disputed relocation refusal

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120 paragraph 5; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

RELOCATION_BOARD_PETITION.description: Raises the petition to the Labour Welfare Committee on a disputed relocation refusal (LPA s.120).

RELOCATION_BOARD_ORDER_RESPONSE.name: Pay relocation compensation ordered or lodge the court challenge

references.title: Labour Protection Act as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562, s.120/1 paragraphs 1 and 4; Royal Gazette volume 136 part 43 Kor, 5 April 2019, Ministry of Labour copy.

RELOCATION_BOARD_ORDER_RESPONSE.description: Raises payment of ordered relocation compensation or the court challenge (LPA s.120/1).

EMPLOYEE_REGISTER_PAYROLL_UPDATE.name: Update the employee register after a payroll agreement change

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.113: the register (name, sex, nationality, birth date, address, start, position, wage and benefits, end) is amended within 15 days of a change. Office of the Council of State English translation.

EMPLOYEE_REGISTER_PAYROLL_UPDATE.description: Raises amendment of the employee register after a contract change within 15 days (LPA s.113).

entity_extension_schema.title: TH entity extension data

The employer's minimum-wage area is one of the by_region keys of the jurisdiction lookup (Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14), Royal Gazette 1 July 2025, in force 1 July 2025 (repeals No. 13 of 23 December 2024 and the hotel notification of 27 March 2024)); its WCF business code is the Social Security Office Table 1 code of the Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 (five digits such as 01111), which sets the base WCF rate.

wcf_rate_percent.title: Experience-rated WCF rate the SSO notified (%)
wcf_rate_percent.description: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.19: from the fifth year of contributions the rate is lowered or raised by the employer's loss ratio and notified by the SSO; recorded here it overrides the Table 1 rate of the employer's WCF business code. https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf This records the actual SSO-notified rate, not a base-table selection; experience discounts or increases can take it outside0.20%–1.00%. Verify the notification; the numeric input range is not proof of legal eligibility.

pvd_employer_percent.title: Provident fund employer contribution rate under the fund rules (%)
pvd_employer_percent.description: Provident Fund Act s.10 as amended in 2015: the employer rate is independently prescribed by the registered fund rules, normally 2%-15% of wages. Required for a member; no employee-rate fallback. https://www.fpo.go.th/main/getattachment/Department/Bureau-of-Legal-Affairs/11/2464/CNT0017302-1.pdf.aspx

minimum_wage_400_business.title: Hotel (category 2-4) or service establishment
minimum_wage_400_business.description: Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14), Royal Gazette 1 July 2025, in force 1 July 2025 (repeals No. 13 of 23 December 2024 and the hotel notification of 27 March 2024): 400 baht a day applies nationwide to hotel businesses of categories 2, 3 and 4 under the hotel law and to service establishments under the Service Establishments Act B.E. 2509, whatever the province.

minimum_wage_exempt.title: Outside the minimum-wage notification
minimum_wage_exempt.description: Wage Committee Notification No. 13 explanatory note item 7 (repeated for No. 14): the minimum wage does not bind central, regional and local government, state enterprises under the state-enterprise labour relations law, employers whose work is not for economic profit, sea-cargo loading or unloading, home work, or agricultural work not employed all year round. https://www.mol.go.th/

files_online.title: Files PND1 / PND1 Kor online

ewf_exempt.title: Business-wide legal or equivalent-welfare EWF exemption
ewf_exempt.description: Record only a verified legal business exemption or qualifying equivalent termination/death welfare covering the employees. Offering a provident fund to only some employees does not exempt others, including probationers and opt-outs. Individual PVD membership is read separately from each employee’s dated statutory standing. DLPW Legal Division guidance 2.2(5)(2), page 6. https://www.siamsafety.com/Employee_welfare_fund.pdf

wcf_instalments.title: WCF contribution paid by instalments (SSO approval)
wcf_instalments.description: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.16-18: a 25% deposit in January and four quarterly instalments.

sdf_exemption.title: Verified Skill Development Fund scope exemption
sdf_exemption.description: Select only with evidence of the legal employer category. Seasonal agriculture covers cultivation, fishing, forestry, animal husbandry or salt production without year-round employees and without related activities. Private schools and private higher education must fall under their respective laws. Non-profit foundations, charitable organisations or organisations established by law must not seek economic profit. State ministries, departments, agencies and organisations are outside Act section 4. Ministry scope notice 9 April 2015 clause 4; DSD official manual กสพ.-01-2568 appendix p.25. NONE retains the ordinary employer duties. Existing unpaid obligations remain payable even if the current category changes.

sdf_registration_reference.description: Verified Department of Skill Development employer registration reference (Sor Tor 1/Sor Tor 4). Record only after checking the registration evidence. An absent reference leaves the company registration task open at headcount >=100; this reference does not prove annual training or fund-payment compliance.

sso_reviewed_rate_percent.title: SSO: documented rate for the southern disaster-relief review
sso_reviewed_rate_percent.description: The nine-province rate of 3 percent for December 2025 to May 2026 applies without any entry (Ministry of Labour notification B.E. 2569, Royal Gazette 8 January 2026). Enter 5 only with an SSO assessment showing the employer is registered outside those provinces; the month and reference below must match it.

sso_rate_review_month.title: SSO: salary month of regional-rate review

sso_rate_review_reference.title: SSO: enacted notification or SSO assessment evidence

region.title: Workplace province
region.description: The province key used by the minimum-wage table and the SSO southern flood relief, for example BANGKOK or CHIANG_MAI_MUEANG.

risk_class.title: WCF business code (Table 1)
risk_class.description: The five-digit Social Security Office Table 1 business code that sets the base Workmen's Compensation Fund rate.

first_employed_on.title: First employee hire date
first_employed_on.description: The date the employer first hired an employee; the SSO employer registration and WCF first-year duties run from it.

ceased_on.title: Business cessation date
ceased_on.description: The date the business ceased; the WCF closing wage statement and final duties run from it.

employee_extension_schema.title: TH employee extension data

work_permit_basis.title: Basis of a foreign worker's permission to work
work_permit_basis.description: Royal Ordinance on the Management of the Employment of Foreign Workers B.E. 2560 s.62: SECTION_62 when the worker is permitted under the investment-promotion, petroleum or another law the section names; the employer is then exempt from the s.13 notices.

sso_excluded_category.title: Outside the Social Security Act (s.4)
sso_excluded_category.description: SSA s.4 and the Royal Decree under it: employment the Act does not cover. https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2019/03/SOCIAL_SECURITY_ACT_2533_SSO_1.pdf

sso_continuing_insured.title: Insured under SSA s.33 before 60 and still insured
sso_continuing_insured.description: SSA s.33 para 2: an employee who was an insured person before reaching 60 and joins this employer without a break in insured employment stays insured after 60; true registers and charges them whatever their age at this contract’s start.

overtime_category.title: Overtime-exempt category (LPA s.65)
overtime_category.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.65: MANAGER — power to hire, reward, cut wages or dismiss for the employer (s.65(1)): no overtime or holiday overtime pay, and no holiday pay unless agreed (s.66); SECTION_65_OTHER — the work listed in s.65(2)-(8): paid 1 × the hourly wage for overtime.

skill_standard_day_rate.title: Skill-standard day rate of the trade
skill_standard_day_rate.description: Wage Committee notification on wage rates by skill standard: the day rate for the worker's certified trade and level.

security_deposit_post.title: Post allowed to take a security deposit
security_deposit_post.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.10 with the Minister's notification on security money.

disabled.description: A disabled person: the 190,000 exemption of the aged or disabled in PND1 (Revenue Code s.42(17)).

section_119_ground.title: Dismissed on a section 119 ground
section_119_ground.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.119: no severance pay where the employee was dismissed for dishonesty, an intentional offence against the employer, wilful damage, a serious breach of work rules after a written warning, three consecutive working days' absence without cause, or imprisonment; s.67 then also withholds annual-leave pay for the year of dismissal.

fixed_term_project.title: End of a fixed-term project, seasonal or occasional contract of up to two years
fixed_term_project.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.118 para 3: no severance.

exit_ground.title: Departure ground
exit_ground.description: The recorded ground of the end of employment; retirement and the s.118 para 3 and s.119 grounds change severance and final-pay duties.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

WCF.title: Workmen's Compensation Fund (กองทุนเงินทดแทน)

wcf_ceiling_review_reference.title: WCF: SSO assessment or proportional-ceiling review evidence

wcf_ceiling_review_tax_year.title: WCF: calendar year of the proportional ceiling

wcf_reviewed_annual_wage_ceiling.title: WCF: reviewed proportional annual wage ceiling (THB)
wcf_reviewed_annual_wage_ceiling.description: For less than a complete calendar year of work, enter the SSO-assessed or independently reviewed proportional wage ceiling under clause11 of the21 February2019 MOL notification. Six full months:120,000. The precise method for a partial calendar month must be verified externally; this seed does not invent a day-count convention.

PVD.title: Provident fund (กองทุนสำรองเลี้ยงชีพ)

employee_percent.title: PVD: member contribution rate (%)
employee_percent.description: Provident Fund Act B.E. 2530 (1987) s.10: a member contributes 2% to 15% of wages to the registered fund the employer set up.

severance_separate.title: PND1: tax severance separately (s.48(5))
severance_separate.description: Revenue Code s.48(5): with at least five years' service, the severance taxed on leaving is withheld apart from other income (Notification No. 45).

child_allowance_count.title: PND1: children qualifying for the child allowance
child_allowance_count.description: Revenue Code s.47(1)(c): 30,000 baht a year for each legitimate or adopted child under 20, or under 25 and studying, or of any age and adjudged incompetent. s.47(3): a non-resident gets this only for children in Thailand, on the annual return, not in payroll.

disabled_dependants_count.title: PND1: disabled dependants (count)
disabled_dependants_count.description: Revenue Code s.47(1)(h): 60,000 for each disabled or incapacitated dependant with income of at most 30,000.

exempt_190k_used_elsewhere.title: PND1: part of the 190,000 exemption used on other income
exempt_190k_used_elsewhere.description: The exemption for a taxpayer aged 65+ or disabled is at most 190,000 across all income.

other_annual_deductions.title: PND1: other annual allowances and deductions declared on Lor Yor 01
other_annual_deductions.description: Revenue Code s.47: deductions the employee declares that have no input of their own here, such as health insurance, prenatal costs, RMF and donations, in baht for the year after their own limits. Everything with its own input (spouse, children, parents, disabled dependants, life, pension and parents’ health insurance, home-loan interest) and social security and the provident fund, which payroll computes, must not be repeated here.

parents_count.title: PND1: parents allowance (count)
parents_count.description: Revenue Code s.47(1)(g): 30,000 for each parent of the taxpayer or of a spouse without income, aged 60+ with income of at most 30,000.

pension_insurance.title: PND1: pension life insurance premiums paid
pension_insurance.description: Up to 15% of income and 200,000, within 500,000 with the provident fund.

previous_employer_income.title: PND1: income from an earlier employer this year
previous_employer_income.description: Tor Por 4/2528: joins the annual estimate (50 Tawi of the earlier employer) only when same_withholding_agent is true; otherwise it is used for annual reconciliation only.

previous_employer_tax.title: PND1: tax withheld by an earlier employer this year
previous_employer_tax.description: Credited against the year's tax only when same_withholding_agent is true; otherwise it is used for annual reconciliation only.

same_withholding_agent.title: PND1: earlier employer is the same withholding agent
same_withholding_agent.description: Tor Por 4/2528: earlier-employer income and tax join this PND1 estimate only when the same withholding agent/declaration continues; otherwise they are left to the employee's annual reconciliation.

second_child_from_2018_count.title: PND1: of those, second and later children born in or after 2018
second_child_from_2018_count.description: Revenue Code s.47(1)(c) as amended by the Revenue Code Amendment Act (No. 49) B.E. 2562: a further 30,000 baht (60,000 in all) for the second and each later legitimate child born on or after 1 January 2018; adopted children do not count ("ยกเว้นบุตรบุญธรรม", Revenue Department https://www.rd.go.th/62777.html).

EWF.employee_amount:
const wages = get(ctx.subtotals, 'ORDINARY_WAGES', ctx.base_pay);
return round(wages * ctx.lookup.rate, ctx.lookup.rounding_step, 'HALF_UP');
EWF.employer_amount:
const wages = get(ctx.subtotals, 'ORDINARY_WAGES', ctx.base_pay);
return Math.max(0, round(wages * ctx.lookup.rate, ctx.lookup.rounding_step, 'HALF_UP'));
EWF.description: Employee Welfare Fund contribution: 0.25% of the month’s ordinary wages each from the employee and the employer, not prorated, from 1 January 2027. Only for employers of ten or more that are not exempt; members of the employer’s provident fund are excluded. HR records the employer exemption and each employee’s standing (Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 ss.126–131; Royal Decree B.E. 2569).
